author: Sp4rrkii
body:
Here is a brand new fresh map by me and _iman. Hope this accepted :D
 
Details

> 2 Monuments
> Pink and Light blue are the team colours
> Diamonds at mid
> Bits coming down from the mid to allow under-bridging
> Materials at back of spawn to maximise Defence capabilities.
> IMPORTANT - XML is still needed 

Album - http://imgur.com/a/LQh52
Thanks 
- Turboh

Please resubmit this map when the edits were made.
